summary: The bubble boi account is very bullish on AI, sees safety warnings as a push for regulatory capture and wants labs held liable for their agents.

statements.quote: The playbook here is regulatory capture.
If they don’t do this then it sets the precedent that anyone who uses an AI agent isn’t liable for damage it might cause either intentionally or unintentionally.
Just like a river boat gambler holding his last chips I’m looking at the landscape and thinking fuck man we are in the fast take off stage right now.
Ai can’t kill every human on earth
Most of you don’t even know what you don’t know and AI can only give you answers to questions you know to ask.
